meta.description: Board graph for the campaign: every location that exists on the start board or is revealed later, plus the sea lanes printed at the start and the routes players are known to build. See NOTES.md for sources, conflicts and inference.

conventions.kind: city has City and Infection cards and can hold a supply center; haven is a sea location with no cards, is never infected, always counts as a production site and cannot be the end of a supply line.
conventions.color: Card color of the city. null where no source shows it.
conventions.startingPopulation: Population printed on the board or on the region sticker when the location appears. Range 0-8.
conventions.coastal: Port location (anchor symbol). Only ports can use Sail, Charter Boat and Chart Sea Lane.
conventions.infested: Printed infested marker on the region sticker. Starting a turn in an infested city exposes the character, like a Plague cube does.
conventions.routes: Supply lines and sea lanes are drawn by the players during the campaign. Only the printed starting sea lanes and the lines printed on region stickers start established. Every other route listed here was built in a documented campaign and is a legal candidate, not a fixed edge. The engine should let players draw any route that passes the geometric rules in legacy-timeline.json (Establish Supply Line, Chart Sea Lane).
conventions.regionLines: Red region lines on the printed board limit sea lanes: a sea lane may cross at most one red line. Known red lines: south of South America at the Drake Passage (also blocks the Magellan Strait), south of Africa at 20E, across the Pacific between East Asia and the Coral Sea, and east of Shanghai along about 20-25N.

regions.label: Atlantic basin
regions.reconCost: Explored at start. Holds the three starting havens and the nine starting cities.

regions.label: North America interior and west coast
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Washington. Discard any 3 blue City cards. Opens Package 1 (map sticker behind door 66). Chicago joins the grid at once by a printed supply line.

regions.label: South America west and south
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Sao Paulo. Discard any 4 yellow City cards. Opens Package 5 (map sticker behind door 67). Buenos Aires joins the grid at once by a printed supply line.

regions.label: Northern and eastern Europe
regions.reconCost: Supply center in London. Discard 4 blue City cards of 4 different cities. Opens Package 4 (map sticker behind door 64). Paris joins the grid at once by a printed supply line.

regions.label: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Lagos. Discard 5 yellow City cards of 5 different cities. Opens Package 7 (door 57). Kinshasa joins the grid at once by a printed supply line. Forced open at the start of July if not done.

regions.label: Middle East and South Asia
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Cairo. Discard 4 black City cards of 4 different cities. Opens Package 2 (doors 62, 53, F, 14). Baghdad joins the grid at once by a printed supply line. Forced open at the start of August if not done.

regions.label: East and Southeast Asia
regions.reconCost: Recon spot at Kolkata is added by a board sticker found behind door 52 (revealed by a Frequency Scanner box). Cost is black City cards of different cities; the exact count was not visible in any source. Opens Package 3 (doors 56, 63). Jakarta joins the grid at once by a printed sea lane. Forced open at the start of October if not done.

regions.label: Southwest Pacific
regions.reconCost: Supply center in Jakarta. Discard any 2 red City cards. Opens door 59, which reveals a ruined haven east of Australia and a further recon spot there.

regions.label: New Zealand
regions.reconCost: Recon from the ruined Coral Sea haven with red City cards (count not recorded). Opens door 19: Wellington, the Topaz lab and a new character.

regions.label: Eastern Pacific lost haven
regions.reconCost: Not a recon. Searching at sea on the Los Angeles or San Francisco City card shows the lost haven. A sea route to it runs from Lima. The first pawn to arrive names it and opens its door.

regions.label: Western Indian Ocean lost haven
regions.reconCost: Not a recon. Searching at sea on New Mumbai, Antananarivo or Dar es Salaam City cards shows the lost haven. Reach it by charting a sea lane. Door 65 is forced open at the start of September if not done.

regions.label: Inner Asia (walled region)
regions.reconCost: Blocked by a wall until the Hollow Men defect (October objective). Then a gap sticker (door 58) says the region opens when The Plan is complete. Completing The Plan (four recons in Shanghai) opens Package 8: Utopia joins the grid. Lake Baikal is reached by a supply line from Utopia in December.

cities.name: North Atlantic Haven
cities.notes: Starting haven. Players name it at campaign start. Character homes are chosen among the named havens.

cities.name: Mediterranean Haven
cities.notes: Starting haven in the western Mediterranean. The rulebook's Sail example from London to Cairo routes through it.

cities.name: South Atlantic Haven
cities.notes: Starting haven near the equator between Brazil and West Africa.

cities.name: Eastern Pacific Haven
cities.notes: Lost haven near the Galapagos. Accessing it is the 'Access a lost haven' objective. The first visit names it and opens its door. One play report says it grants a permanent +15 Supply cube bonus to the stockpile each game; another credits that bonus to the Opal lab package (see NOTES.md).

cities.name: Indian Ocean Haven
cities.notes: Lost haven near the Seychelles. The first visit grants +15 Supply cubes to the stockpile at once and in every later game. Hollow Men can be moved onto havens (October objective).

cities.name: Coral Sea Haven (ruined)
cities.notes: Ruined haven revealed by the Jakarta recon. It has its own recon spot that leads to Wellington.

cities.name: New York
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Washington
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for North America.

cities.name: Jacksonville
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Sao Paulo
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for South America.

cities.name: London
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for Europe.

cities.name: Istanbul
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Tripoli
cities.notes: Starting city.

cities.name: Cairo
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for the Middle East.

cities.name: Lagos
cities.notes: Starting city. Recon spot for Africa.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when North America is reconned (printed supply line). One source remembers its population as 1; the sticker photo shows 2.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.notes: City card has land and sea search boxes. The sea search shows the eastern Pacific lost haven.

cities.name: Atlanta
cities.notes: City card has a search box whose reward is a one-time removal of one card from the Infection discard pile for the rest of the game.

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.notes: City card has land and sea search boxes. The sea search shows the eastern Pacific lost haven.

cities.name: Mexico City
cities.notes: Search reveals a companion who helps swap City cards.

cities.name: Bogota
cities.notes: Search reward: remove one card from the Infection discard pile. Color inferred from the region's sticker colors.

cities.name: Lima
cities.notes: A sea route to the eastern Pacific lost haven starts here. Search reveals a companion.

cities.name: Buenos Aires
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when South America is reconned. City card search boxes: sea search finds a supply cache, land search finds the Opal lab (opens Package 6).

cities.name: Paris
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when Europe is reconned (printed supply line from London).

cities.name: St. Petersburg
cities.notes: City card has land and sea search boxes.

cities.name: Moscow
cities.notes: Black city in the Europe region. Its card is often the fourth unique black card needed for the Cairo recon.

cities.name: Kinshasa
cities.notes: Printed infested. Joins the grid automatically when Africa is reconned (printed supply line from Lagos). Search reveals a companion who lowers the satellite tower cost.

cities.name: Khartoum
cities.notes: Printed infested. Search reward: a one-time action to give a City card to any player anywhere.

cities.name: Dar es Salaam
cities.notes: Printed infested. Sea search shows the Indian Ocean lost haven.

cities.name: Antananarivo
cities.notes: Sea search shows the Indian Ocean lost haven.

cities.name: Johannesburg
cities.notes: Search finds the Jade lab. Final objective destination: the sample must reach a supply center here.

cities.name: Baghdad
cities.notes: Printed infested. Joins the grid automatically when the Middle East is reconned (printed supply line toward Cairo).

cities.name: Tehran
cities.notes: Search reward: remove two Hollow Men figures from the board.

cities.name: Delhi
cities.notes: Printed infested.

cities.name: New Mumbai
cities.notes: Printed infested. Sea search shows the Indian Ocean lost haven.

cities.name: Kolkata
cities.notes: Printed infested. Gains a recon spot for East Asia from a later sticker. Its City card has no search box.

cities.name: Jakarta
cities.notes: Joins the grid automatically when East Asia is reconned. Recon spot for the Coral Sea region. The package text says 'the Player card' and 'the Infection card' (singular) for Jakarta.

cities.name: Manila
cities.notes: Printed infested.

cities.name: Shanghai
cities.notes: Printed infested. Site of the four Plan recons (November). No supply center is needed for those recons.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.notes: Printed infested.

cities.name: Osaka
cities.notes: Printed infested.

cities.name: Wellington
cities.notes: Revealed by the recon from the Coral Sea haven (door 19). Holds the Topaz lab. Described as untouched by the plague.

cities.name: Utopia
cities.notes: Printed infested marker. Inaccessible until the Hollow Men defect. Package 8 connects it to the grid and adds 8 Utopia Infection cards: shuffled into the Infection deck if The Plan was completed, placed in the Infection discard pile if Package 8 was forced open in December. Reached from Shanghai by supply line. Population 8 is inferred from a play report (7 after losing 1).

cities.name: Lake Baikal
cities.notes: Holds the Pearl lab and the cure sample. Its coordinates are given early by a lab-coordinates card. Joined to the grid by a supply line from Utopia. Self-Infect happens here.
